title: carmichaelia uniflora var. suteri
intro: Carmichaelia uniflora var. suteri, commonly known as the New Zealand flax lily or New Zealand spider lily, is a flowering plant species native to New Zealand. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and sore throats. The health benefits of Carmichaelia uniflora var. suteri include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of soothing skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
